args.body:
Dear New Asiaway Private Dining Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I would like to request a table for 12 people for next Friday, May 24, 2024.

Could you please let me know if a table for 12 is available on that date, and if so, what time slots you would recommend? I would also appreciate any information about private dining options or set menus for a group of this size.

Thank you very much for your assistance. I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Email: emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
Phone: 327-420-4923
